> 和你们说点事（第1页）
我知道，上一本后期断更的事情很伤大家，虽然后面恢复更新也写全本了。
但中间断了那么久，确实做的很烂。
原因不辩解了，事实就是这么一个事实。
其实说什么都挺苍白的，用行动吧。
这本书我不拼月票，也不向你们求月票了。
（章节下带的求月票的字样只是新年的时候求个彩头，意思意思就好了。
我想说的是，月票榜这个东西，我这本书就先不求大家支持我了。
话讲的更明白点，意思是：【你们有月票就投给你们觉得更值得的书吧。
以我上本书后期的更新表现，我自己也觉得不配。
一年时间，如果我更新表现稳定，大家觉得我人品修复的不错，我才会开口要你们的月票。
还有个事情，很多人开玩笑说，两年后再看，三年后再看，五年后再看……
玩笑开开就算了吧，真这么养的话，书就写不下去了。
因为，如果数据不好的话，起点也是会让作者提前完结的。
现在起点的规则已经变了，一切看数据，就连推荐资源都看数据。
数据不好，那就没有资源，白金也一样。
数据不好，那就提前完结，白金也一样。
大数据说了算，编辑手里没多少权限的。
所以，如果你养着不看，书就没数据。

没数据，就没资源，然后官方可能会要求我提前完结掉。
这本书我构思的框架不大，大概一年半会写完。
我先好好更新吧，一年后，我更新如果一直很稳定，我会开口向你们求月票的。
在这之前，把你们的月票留给更值得的作者和书，我现在还不配。

Hurry up and collect your magical powers! The latest chapter_Let me tell you something Page 1_Hurry up and collect your magical powers! Dancing_hot novel website
> Tell you something (page 1)
I know that the discontinuation of the last book at the end of the period hurt everyone, although it will be updated later and the whole book will be written.
But after such a long break, it was really bad.
There is no excuse for the reason, it is just a fact.
In fact, nothing can be said, so let’s take action.
I won’t fight for a monthly pass for this book, and I won’t ask you for a monthly pass.
(The words asking for monthly tickets at the bottom of the chapter are just asking for a lucky draw during the New Year, so that’s fine.
What I want to say is that I won’t ask everyone to support me for this book as far as the monthly vote list is concerned.
To put it more clearly, it means: [If you have a monthly vote, just vote for the book you think is more worthwhile.
Based on the updated performance in the later stages of my last book, I myself feel unworthy.
In one year's time, if my update performance is stable and everyone thinks my character has been restored well, I will ask for your monthly passes.
Another thing, many people joke, watch it again in two years, watch it again after three years, watch it again after five years...
Just kidding, if you really do this, you won't be able to write the book.
Because, if the data is not good, the starting point will also let the author finish it early.
Now the rules of Qidian have changed. Everything depends on data, even recommended resources depend on data.
If the data is not good, then there will be no resources, and the same goes for platinum.
If the data is not good, then end it early, and the same goes for platinum.
Big data has the final say, and editors don’t have much authority.
Therefore, if you don’t read it, the book will have no data.
Without data, there will be no resources, and then the official may ask me to finish it in advance.
I have a small framework for this book, and it will take about a year and a half to finish.
I will update it properly first. After one year, if my updates are stable, I will ask you for monthly votes.
Until then, leave your monthly passes to more deserving authors and books. I don’t deserve them right now.
